blocks.title: Superfluidity
blocks.text: Superfluidity fluids ki woh khusoosiyat hai jahan un ki viscosity sifr ho ya woh raghrat se paak hon. Yeh khusoosiyat dikhane wala madda superfluid hai. Superfluids kinetic energy ke nuqsan ke baghair bahte hain. Laboratory mein superfluids kuch maddon mein cryogenic temperature par bante hain, absolute zero se zyada oopar nahi. Woh na-qabil-e-yaqeen tang jagahon se baghair kisi rukawat ke beh sakte hain, aur gravity ko challenge kar ke us ke khilaf oopar beh sakte hain (Fig. 5.24).

Superfluids aisa anokha rawayya dikhate hain jo aam fluids aur gases mein nahi. Helium-3 bartan ki deewaron par charh kar nikal sakta hai, jo film flow kehlata hai, aur bartan ki deewaron se guzar bhi sakta hai. Hilane par superfluids mustaqil bhanwar banate hain, aam fluids ke baraks jo theher jate hain. Jab superfluid ka bartan ghumaya jaye to andar ka liquid sakin rehta hai, coffee ke cup ke baraks. Superfluids normal aur superfluid ajza ke mixture par mushtamil hain, kam temperature par zyada superfluid maujood. Kuch superfluids ki thermal conductivity zyada aur compressibility mukhtalif hoti hai. Superfluidity superconductivity se mukhtalif hai: superfluids helium-3 aur helium-4 dono bijli nahi guzarte. Superfluids deewaron par aur bartanon ke kinaron se oopar charh sakte hain kyunke woh aam fluids ki tarah raghrat mehsoos nahi karte (Tidbits).

Superfluid helium-4 superfluidity ki sab se zyada parhi gayi misal hai: yeh apne boiling point -452 degrees F (-269 degrees C ya 4 K) se bas chand degree neeche liquid se superfluid ban jata hai. Superfluid helium-4 aam saaf liquid ki tarah chalta hai magar us mein viscosity nahi, to ek bar bahna shuru kare to kisi bhi rukawat ke paas se chalta rehta hai. Doosri misalein: superfluid helium-3; kuch Bose-Einstein condensates (sab nahi); atomic rubidium-85; lithium-6 atoms (50 nK par); atomic sodium; mumkinan neutron stars ke andar.

Filhal superfluids ke amali istemalat kam hain. Superfluid helium-4 high-field magnets ke liye coolant ka kaam karta hai; helium-3 aur helium-4 dono jadeed particle detectors mein istemal hote hain; superfluidity par tehqeeq superconductivity ke bare mein mazeed seekhne mein bhi madad deti hai. Liquid helium apni bari thermal conductivity ke liye jana jata hai aur cryogenic istemalat mein kaam aata hai, jin mein superconducting magnets ko thanda karna, scientific tehqeeq aur tibbi istemalat shamil hain; sanat mein yeh leak testing aur electronic aur optical products ki paidawar mein bhi istemal hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Superfluid ki bunyadi khusoosiyat kya hai (MCQ 5.12), aur us ka mutaala kam-temperature physics ke liye kyun aham hai (constructed response 5.6)?
blocks.explanation: Sifr viscosity. Superfluids sirf absolute zero ke qareeb nazar aate hain aur nazar aane wale paimane par quantum rawayya dikhate hain, jaise mustaqil bhanwar aur film flow; un ka mutaala Bose-Einstein condensation ke nazriye parakhta hai aur superconductivity samjhane mein madad deta hai, aur liquid helium kam-temperature laboratories ka kaam ka coolant hai.

items: Superfluid: sifr viscosity, raghrat se paak, KE ka nuqsan nahi; absolute zero ke qareeb banta hai; tang jagahon se bahta, deewaron par charhta (film flow), mustaqil bhanwar, ghoomte bartan mein sakin; superconductor nahi. Helium-4 (taqreeban 4 K se neeche), helium-3, kuch Bose-Einstein condensates, Rb-85, Li-6, Na, neutron stars. Istemalat: magnet coolant, particle detectors, cryogenics, leak testing.
